input.business_intent: Which is the highest selling product?

args.sql_query:
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM AVG(quantity::INTERVAL)) AS INT) as avg_quantity_per_transaction,
    CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(total_amount::INTERVAL)) AS BIGINT) as total_sales_amount,
    CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(quantity::INTERVAL)) AS BIGINT) as total_quantity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(total_amount::INTERVAL)) AS BIGINT) DESC) as sales_rank
FROM highest_selling_products
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    CAST(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM quantity)) AS INT) as avg_quantity_per_transaction,
    CAST(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM total_amount)) AS BIGINT) as total_sales_amount,
    CAST(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM quantity)) AS BIGINT) as total_quantity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM total_amount)) AS BIGINT) DESC) as sales_rank
FROM highest_selling_products
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as sales_rank
FROM highest_selling_products
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as sales_rank
FROM highest_selling_products
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rank_number
FROM highest_selling_products
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
